subject: How to change the sample rate in a bin file (GENEActive)

messages.author: 147db09c5e034b56
messages.subject: How to change the sample rate in a bin file (GENEActive)
parts:
Hello everyone,

I hope someone from the community can help me with this big problem I'm having. My bin file has 10 samples per second, and I need GGIR to process it with a sampling frequency of 60 samples per minute. I tried incorporating an external function into GGIR:

# Define your resampling function
resample_to_600mpm <- function(data, parameters) {
  # Original sampling frequency (10 Hz)
  original_sampling_frequency <- parameters$expected_sample_rate
 
  # Target sampling frequency (600 measures per minute)
  target_sampling_frequency <- 600 / 60  # 600 measures per minute
 
  # Resample the data
  resampled_data <- resample(data, original_sampling_frequency, target_sampling_frequency)
 
  return(resampled_data)
}

# Provide the resampling function as a list to GGIR
myfun <- list(
  FUN = resample_to_600mpm,
  parameters = list(
    expected_sample_rate = 10  # Assuming your original data has a sampling rate of 10 Hz
  ),
  expected_sample_rate = 600 / 60,  # Target sampling rate (600 measures per minute)
  expected_unit = "g",  # Update this with the unit of your data if applicable
  colnames = c("countsX","countsY","countsZ"),  # Provide column names if necessary
  outputres = 1,  # Output resolution
  minlength = 1,  # Minimum length
  outputtype = "numeric",  # Output type
  aggfunction = sum,  # Aggregation function
  timestamp = FALSE,  # Whether timestamps are included in the data
  reporttype = "scalar"  # Report type
)

But I end up with this error: Error in if (myfun$reporttype[rti] == "event") { : missing value where TRUE/FALSE needed

So I looked it up and understood that in the windowsizes = c(5,900,3600) parameter, I could modify the epochs... so in my GGIR code I changed this parameter to windowsizes = c(60,900,3600). GGIR works, but when I look at the results, I see that it does not apply cosinor, for example, I don't have the cosinor_amp parameters and others.

GGIR::GGIR(
  mode=c(1,2,3,4,5),#which of the five parts need to be run
  datadir="Input_nuevobin",
  outputdir="Output_nuevobin",
  do.report=c(2,4,5),
  #myfun= myfun,
  windowsizes = c(60,900,3600),
  minimumFileSizeMB = 0,
 
  # other parameters ...

messages.author: e0169f921473cc94
messages.subject: Re: How to change the sample rate in a bin file (GENEActive)
parts:
Do you have cosinor = TRUE set in your other GGIR parameters section? The default for this parameter is FALSE.

The cosinor_amp column should be present in part2_summary.csv file when setting that configuration option to TRUE.

Good luck!
